title: LogStream
description: Represents a logical log stream, dataset, index, or log group within a logging platform that organizes ingested log events.

id.description: Stable identifier for the log stream within the logging platform.

name.description: Human-readable name of the log stream, dataset, or index.

description.description: Description of what this log stream contains and who owns it.
description.example: Stdout and stderr logs from the checkout-api service in production.

platform.description: Logging platform that hosts the stream.

ingestion_endpoint.description: Endpoint URL used to ingest log events into this stream.

format.description: Wire format expected by the ingestion endpoint.

retention.description: Retention configuration applied to this log stream.

hot_days.description: Number of days events remain in the hot (searchable) tier.

cold_days.description: Number of additional days events remain in cold or archive storage.

archive_url.description: Archive destination for raw log data after the hot window expires.

labels.description: Indexed labels or tags attached to all events in the stream.

estimated_volume_gb_per_day.description: Estimated daily ingestion volume in gigabytes.

status.description: Operational status of the log stream.
